description: Recursively checks a node (and its children) against the current DS enforcement profile — flags hardcoded colors/fonts instead of variables/styles, missing text style bindings, and other DS violations. Use during Phase 3/4 QA, especially at the 20-op build checkpoint, before generating the report. Params: nodeId (required, typically the artboard root).

nodeId.description: The Figma node ID to validate.

name: figma_validate_ds_compliance
